hypothesis.preserved_v6_state: Ordinary FAR remains eligible only from an exclusively rejection-framed auction.
hypothesis.v7_rejected_observation: Replacing the inherited second-pullback limit with confirmation-time AAC market entry produced two AAC trades and both lost. The improvement in aggregate NAV came from four no-trades, not positive AAC expectancy.
hypothesis.causal_defect: The current AAC label does not distinguish durable inventory transfer from temporary outside acceptance. A deep boundary re-entry is evidence against acceptance, but the same bar cannot both reveal failure and own a reversal.
hypothesis.single_state_space_change: The incomplete AAC continuation branch remains flat. For any acceptance-origin event, first record the frozen deep boundary re-entry. Only a later completed opposite initiative through that failure bar, with the existing displacement/flow/location rules, may own a reversal. Invalidation belongs beyond the failure-bar extreme and the target must be a still-live opposing external draw.
hypothesis.unchanged: Liquidity detection, pool identity, source boundary, opposing target selection, displacement thresholds, market-leadership semantics, costs, current-NAV 3% sizing, Session I7, global arbitration and NautilusTrader execution/accounting are unchanged.
hypothesis.interpretation_rule: The interval was previously inspected. V8 is a mechanism diagnostic and cannot establish success regardless of performance.

research_question: Does replacing the unresolved AAC continuation label with an explicit two-stage failure transition create independently owned, cost-executable reversals without reintroducing mixed-origin same-bar relabelling?

selection.method: Controlled replay of the previously inspected Candidate 14 L1 interval. V6 is the source baseline; V7 supplies rejection evidence for immediate AAC continuation. L1 is permanently ineligible for a success claim or future holdout use.

strategy_change_control.single_change: replace incomplete AAC continuation with later-initiative accepted-auction failure resolution
